blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States—New York authorities said Thursday that eight people, including two children, were killed after a residential building collapsed a day earlier. The disaster prompted a frantic overnight search by firefighters to pull people from the rubble. The three-story property in Brooklyn fell Wednesday afternoon into a neighboring excavation site where construction workers had been preparing foundations for a planned development. “This has been a devastating morning and evening for our city,” said New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who announced the latest death toll and said over a dozen more were injured.
